Mes chers Frères,
Votre lettre en date d’hier.
Joseph Mizrahi dit que vous avez reçu du jour ... Pour les B.O. de la somme de L.E 1220 et qu’il leur reste un arriéré de 188 L.E que j’ai arrêté chez nous. Mizrahi ... je vous écrirai à la fin de la lettre.

... Comme écrit hier, à Monsieur ... a payé le reste de la salle ... Fakhri à L.E 12 près. Je suis arrivé à encaisser L.E 50 à votre crédit ... mais il n’est pas sorti du magasin; et il a pris pour ... un avoir au sujet de la facture des ... J’espère demain vous écrire à ce sujet. En ce que vous avez en liquide ... car il paye régulièrement ...

Cairo, 23 June 1936

My dear brothers,
Your letter dated yesterday.
Joseph Mizrahi says that you received for the day ... For the B.O. the amount of L.E. 1220 and that there remains an arrear of L.E. 188 which I have recorded with us. I hope you have sent the orders. He believes that between our return from the hotel ... he passed in my ... from the shop L.E. 40–90. I hope to send you tomorrow ... not ... Mizrahi ... I will write to you at the end of the letter.

... As written yesterday, to Monsieur ... has paid the remainder of the hall ... Fakhri at about L.E. 12. I managed to collect L.E. 50 to your credit ... but it has not left the shop; and he took for ... a credit note regarding the invoice for ... I hope to write to you tomorrow on this matter. As for what you have in cash ... because he pays regularly ...
